title: OAuth Authorization Server Metadata
description: The RFC 8414 metadata the Company's issuer publishes, with the fields Poppy requires. Spec section 3.2 (OAuth server). Other fields are allowed, and Personal Agents ignore them. grant_types_supported says which of Direct and Device Sign-In the Company offers: authorization_endpoint is required when it includes authorization_code, and device_authorization_endpoint when it includes the device_code grant. Publishing scopes_supported and a complete scope inventory is recommended. Endpoint conditions and scope recommendations are checked separately.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description: RFC 8414 section 2. Accepted client-assertion algorithms, not delegation algorithms. Poppy requires ES256 and recommends PS384.

grant_types_supported.description: Must include refresh_token, which is checked separately.

protected_resources.description: RFC 9728 section 4. Lists https://{domain} for every domain whose issuer it is, and may list other resources.
